citation.authors: Hayashi M, Hamada H, Azuma SI, Hayashi K

cited_by.title: Ashwagandha: cortisol, mood, skin, hair, heart, kidneys and liver

record.finding: Painless thyroiditis with an overactive thyroid two months after starting ashwagandha; symptoms and thyroid blood tests improved after he stopped.
record.note: One case. The 2018 India trial in the existing ashwagandha card reported better thyroid tests in people with an underactive thyroid, so the thyroid evidence points both ways.
